summary_zh: 泰國工業部長下令加強全國工業廢料處理及回收工廠的檢查與執法，在泰華商需強化廢料合規。同時泰中擬簽MOU共建汽車產業基地、推動EV與智慧汽車，汽車零件轉型EV的壓力持續上升；台商投資研討會則聚焦跨國人才與稅務議題。
summary_en: Thailand's industry minister ordered stricter nationwide inspections of industrial waste and recycling plants. A planned Thailand-China MOU on an auto hub adds EV transition pressure on parts makers. A Taiwanese investment seminar focused on cross-border talent and tax.
